question_text: A 55-year-old man presents with crushing chest pain radiating to the left arm. Which enzyme rises first after myocardial infarction?
explanation_text: Troponin I is the most sensitive and specific early marker used clinically for MI.

question_text: Which finding is most characteristic of tension pneumothorax?
option_b: Tracheal deviation away from the affected side
explanation_text: Air under pressure shifts the mediastinum and trachea away from the affected side.

question_text: The most common organism causing surgical site infection after clean-contaminated abdominal surgery is:
explanation_text: Gram-negative enteric flora predominate after clean-contaminated GI procedures.
